# Vendored header origin

Copied unchanged from the user-provided prototype dependency:
`Prototypes/Source/ThirdParty/NVRHI/nvrhi_v22/thirdparty/Vulkan-Headers`.

Includes Vulkan-Headers and Vulkan-Hpp, `VK_HEADER_VERSION = 328`.
Upstream: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers

The `include` tree, `LICENSE.md` and `LICENSES` directory retain their original
contents and notices. No Unreal OpenGLDrv or VulkanRHI implementation is vendored here.
